subject: general
question:
Study the given pattern carefully and select the number that can replace the question mark (?) in it.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8a76d1b8a748762ea890af70b8aaf3c93886c3e6f86ee802605020ae8e70dd4f.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a2cfecea7008f23c425e3e200c84f32e0ca1189f99fbd72bd99089423faac6ab.png]
solution:
The logic followed here is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3abb9e6c2f1aef50691fa1631eb5232cd3e18e2af476f2cb419850a5ee80fdc4.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a09c2f3b2f9fd7e2d4918dc9279ea52297e811cbfd8e7f3c008a9b24c1f0ab85.png] 

4 × 5 = 12 + 8

20 = 20 (LHS = RHS)

And,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9929f132cce7ed7c37147c13b1112615228a16a1c822912bbb9917f404576825.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b5955e21ad3f0f236a1bc8617f98f34b25b92d7c9f86741506ab50e24f3b129a.png] 

5 × 3 = 7 + 8

15 = 15 (LHS = RHS)

Similarly,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2061e4196d5fd6f2cf434f630efed6ff78f9cf14668a5218a471f25b59246a84.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/add32c961aaafe9a09fc77e5b00d40d5d9dd1e273e4a9b214177e1be188eb98a.png] 

6 × 4 = ? + 8

24 - 8 = ?

**16 = ?**

Hence, **"Option 2" **is the correct answer.
